═══ HANDOFF FOR CONTEXT COMPACTION (2026-09-03) — read this first ═══

## ROLE
Debug orchestrator: owns all UNPARENTED bugs, plus epic 6202 as of this session. Drives work via subagents; does not implement directly. Parallel sessions own three other epics.

## CLOSED THIS SESSION (4 orphan bugs, 12 changes merged)
- **febd** curbable-regardable-lemming — uv required-version ==0.12.7 vs floating uv:latest broke EVERY container build; the box could not deploy at all. Closed class=regression, caused_by 56b7. Changes 2558 (fix + guard), 2584 (alarm description cap).
- **3a02** lowly-lawrencium-ovenbird — MCP models under-declared 41 schema properties; baseline drained. Change 2556.
- **4f59** infertile-mindful-rodent — argparse colorization on py3.14. Change 2568. Scope was far larger than filed: 25 failures across 9 modules, TWO of them product regressions (stale generated help artifacts; usage wrapping on ANSI-inflated length).
- **f0d1** neutral-skyblue-hog — select_from_corpus eager per-ticket compile. Change 2590. ~110x: 74.2s vs ~2h15m.

## LIVE IN PRODUCTION (applied, verified)
- 12 rebar/host alarms flipped to treat_missing_data=breaching with anti-flap windows (bff5, change 2551).
-  on mcp_healthy — the MCP outage was invisible for 12h; it is not now (9ea3, changes 2565+2584).
-  on data_disk_debris_bytes, 1 GiB threshold, reading 0 (3276 AC5, change 2586).
- Memory instrumentation: mem_available_percent / mem_used_percent / mem_probe_ok / container_memory_rss_bytes (4 stable service dims) / container_stats_ok, plus the GATE_PEAK_RSS marker (9ea3, change 2589).

## OPEN BUGS — state and what each needs
- **3276** cyclopean-bloodshot-hoatzin — 5 of 6 ACs met. AC1 ticked via operator-accepted REPLAY (induced publish-stop rejected as 12-alarm noise). Only **AC4 (bounded ceiling) remains, owned by epic 6202**. Closes when the epic delivers, or on an operator decision to attribute AC4 to the epic.
- **bff5** herbal-garish-monkey — AC2 REWRITTEN and MET by replay (operator principle: an AC that depends on time passing is defective). 24h replay: 27 missing periods absorbed, ZERO missing-data transitions; 3 alarms transitioned, all TRUE POSITIVES. Remaining: AC3 induced fetch-failure on mirror_out_of_sync, AC6 enumeration.
- **9ea3** witted-invisible-roan — AC1/AC2/AC3 met, AC4 landed. **OOM arithmetic now SETTLED**: operator states ~10 plan reviews run in parallel; 10 x ~739 MB + 2.17 GB steady state = ~9.6 GB on an 8 GiB host. AC5 needs a box-side gate measurement (today's numbers are from a LOCAL CLI run).

## EPIC 6202 — claimed, in progress
Title: 'Bounded disk-ceiling architecture for the Gerrit host'. Claimed (attestation PASS at ebbcd7a030d6, needed a retry after an llm-degrade INDETERMINATE).

**Tree is a SERIAL CHAIN, 7 stories.** S2-S5 are NOT file-disjoint (all touch observability.sh, compose-up.sh, install-disk-ceilings.sh), so this lands as ONE STACK, not parallel worktrees:

    S0 7dfa livid-blondish-shearwater      ADR 0110                         READY, review-plan running
     +- S6 09da grusome-ecumenical-polarbear  fast-fail gate admission      NEW this session
     |    +- S2 9183 geode-joking-cockatiel    Docker overlay2 + BuildKit cap
     |    +- S3 e956 divine-streaky-betafish   journald SystemMaxUse
     |    +- S4 2ba3 unmelted-grieving-blowfish /var/tmp
     |    +- S5 910b francium-written-squid    writable container layers
     +- S1 aa40 injurious-wellmade-moth      dedicated gate-scratch EBS

**S6 is new and load-bearing.** Operator input: ~10 parallel reviews. janitor.py relies on POSIX delete-on-last-close and takes NO reader lease (a PID+heartbeat lease was spiked and REJECTED as unsound). So it can unlink an in-flight snapshot but the blocks do not return until the last reader closes — under peak concurrency the held bytes are LIVE, not garbage, and a high-water-mark GC has nothing to evict. **A cap below peak concurrent hold cannot be honoured**, which is why S6 gates S2-S5. Design: configurable limit shared by plan-review AND completion-verifier (both snapshot the repo at a ref); at capacity FAST-FAIL with a congestion message, never queue — a queued gate still holds its thread and ~739 MB.

**Operator decisions carried:** Option A + C approved, do not re-litigate. Every capped generator gets its own alarm. Root stays 60 GiB (headroom, not the fix). Cap values = measured defaults, settable by config.

**Gate advisories still to honour:** epic AC4 (3276 non-regression) is covered by NO child; S2/S5 overlap (writable layers live in overlay2 — one budget, not two); S4 conflicts with 3e92's /var/tmp/rebar-evidence location.

## IN FLIGHT — 3 subagents, none pushed
1. **reb-split-sizing** (change 2593, Verified -1): fixing a REAL breakage — test_review_discovery_architecture._PROJECTION_BUILDERS hardcodes sizing.py and asserts it constructs DiscoveryStagePlan; the split moved that to checkpoints.py.
2. **reb-split-composer** (change 2594, Verified -1): classifying an e2e worker crash (test_editor_e2e gw0 crashed). Evidence it is NOT the split: passes on clean main locally, and the identical crash hit 2593, an independent change. Must be classified, not rechecked — project policy forbids retry-as-fix.
3. **reb-6202-disk-ceiling**: drafting ADR 0110 (S0). Not committed; awaiting S0's claim.

**Change 2596** (acli.py split, 800->567) was CI-running at handoff — check it.

## MODULE SPLITS — all three at-cap modules done
2593 sizing 800->547 (+budget 168, +checkpoints 144); 2594 composer 800->508 (composer_edit 188->490); 2596 acli 800->567 (acli_rest 340->585). **No src/rebar file is at the 800 cap now.** Nine remain at 794-799 — next batch if wanted.

## CARRY-OVERS not acted on
minio:latest in docker-compose.langfuse.yml; bridge suggest-mapping's parser built outside the RebarArgumentParser family (_cli/__init__.py:147); autodeploy.sh is 1313 lines and UNGATED (module-size gate is src/rebar Python only) — two defects found in it this session.

## RECURRING HAZARDS (cost time this session)
- **/tmp is shared across parallel agents** — one clobbered another's backup mid-proof. Use the worktree or CLAUDE_JOB_DIR.
- **Test harness guards fail if repo HEAD moves mid-sweep** — do not commit during a full suite run.
- **'Missing tree' push rejection = STALE BASE, not corruption.** Rebase onto the current gerrit tip; recurred twice.
- **git commit --amend --no-edit produces NO_CODE_CHANGE** and Gerrit COPIES a -1 forward instead of re-reviewing. Use  (CONTRIBUTING §2) to re-trigger, not a manufactured edit.
- **make amend-msg amends the MESSAGE ONLY** — verify with git show --stat that code edits are in the commit.
- **origin (GitHub) lags gerrit** — fetch from gerrit after a submit or you get a stale tree.
